title: LogicalDiagram
description: LLM-facing pivot for the v2 drawio pipeline. See logical_diagram.go for the Go type + docs/modules/doc-engine/drawio/concepts.md for the design.

viewpoint.description: Catalog URI of the viewpoint that draws the diagram (e.g. ktw-docs:/viewpoint/archimate3-layered): a notation, its template library and a layout profile.

title.description: Optional human-readable title of the diagram.

nodes.description: Diagram nodes. At least one is required.

zones.description: Named partitions (swimlanes / containers) over subsets of nodes.

mark.description: The production mark under the diagram (ArchiFactory, its version, the date): on when omitted, off removes it, or a text of its own.

Page.description: The frame the diagram is drawn in: a page template of the viewpoint's library, and the values of its placeholders.

name.description: Page template name (e.g. dossier); empty keeps the viewpoint's page.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the diagram.

kind.description: An element kind of the viewpoint's notation.

attributes.description: Free-form per-node data; templates read scalar values as %key% placeholders and bindings read paths like attributes.domain.

zone.description: Optional zone id (must reference an entry in zones[]).

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the diagram.

kind.description: A relationship kind of the viewpoint's notation.

attributes.description: Free-form per-edge data; templates read scalar values as %key% placeholders and bindings read paths like attributes.fl_codes.

order.description: Partition ordering (left-to-right or top-to-bottom by layout direction). Zero-based, monotonic within a diagram.

members.description: Optional explicit member node ids. Either this OR node.zone fields assign membership; both is allowed.

parent.description: The zone this one is drawn inside (a lane in its pool).

kind.description: The zone's look: the template library's zone:<kind> template (an AWS Region, a VPC).

preset.description: Named preset (e.g. archi-layered, layered-right, force). When set, wins over algorithm + direction.

elkOptions.description: Raw ELK layout options that win over the preset's.

lanes.description: Draw zones as lanes: bands across the reading direction (BPMN pools and lanes).

laneHeader.description: Where a lane's label sits: side (the default) or top (boxes inside boxes).
